mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic context.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals labor market overheating that triggers inflation fears and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and federal funds rate hikes (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%) signal aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high housing demand regimes (HOUST > 1500), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1500 and INDPRO declines, or conditional Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 100,000 monthly increase) signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by >100,000 jobs, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production below 100.0 (INDPRO < 100.0) signals manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) below 0.5% YoY signal broad consumer demand weakness that depresses corporate revenue growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline >0.5% YoY, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In low-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS declines, or conditional Rank IC falls below 0.03.
